project_type: Pure static HTML site (single-page) hosting Government ashram school Computer & AI exam question papers in Marathi/English, grades 1-10
language: HTML + inline CSS/JS, bilingual Marathi (Devanagari) / English content
build_system: none - static site, no build step, no package manager
test_framework: none - verification is manual: read the HTML and re-sum sec-marks per paper
test_command: none automated; verification = grep sec-marks/meta totals and re-sum per paper to confirm each edited paper sums to exactly 20; validate HTML structure balance
verification_instructions: For each edited paper (Std 5,6,7,8,9,10): (1) extract the sec-marks spans and confirm the Devanagari numerals sum to exactly 20; (2) confirm meta-chips last span reads 'एकूण गुण: २० (Max Marks: 20)'; (3) confirm each section's sec-marks equals the number of gradable q-item/rows in it (1 mark/item) unless explicit per-question [N गुण] tags sum correctly; (4) confirm Q.N numbering is sequential with no gaps/duplicates within each paper; (5) for match sections: rows == stated marks == ans-input boxes; (6) confirm Std 8,9,10 each still contain a descriptive/theory section (विभाग E short-answer and/or विभाग F application) carrying real marks; (7) confirm Std 1,2,3,4 are byte-identical to origin/main; (8) run a tag-balance sanity check (count of opening vs closing article/div).
setup_instructions: Repo already cloned at /projects/sandbox/ashram-school-exam-papers. Work is on branch rebalance-papers-20-marks (already created off latest origin/main which includes merged PR #2 answer-shuffle). No dependencies to install.
environment_constraints: No external network needed. No build/test tooling. All work is careful text editing of index.html plus a small markdown table update.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator handles). Preserve merged PR #2 shuffled answer positions - never reset correct options back to position A. Preserve all bilingual text, HTML structure, CSS classes. Std 1,2,3,4 must be byte-untouched.
